concerns.text: The data model defines a ‘Narrative Representation (Pre‑training)’ entity (a .pt file of hidden‑state vectors from the SAE during ROCStories pre‑training). The plan’s Phase 2 tasks (e.g., T050.4) train the SAE on the ROCStories corpus but never specify saving or validating this pre‑training representation artifact, leaving the entity unused and violating Plan ↔ Data‑Model consistency.
